discipline: Separate registration artifact. The locked predictions/prediction_registry.json is NOT edited. Hypothesis and threshold below were fixed in the scout-058 record (merged to main before this census was run as a resolution) and in issue #268 before the resolution scan; an informal maintainer count taken while verifying the scout is disclosed in the resolution, not hidden.
claim_under_test: Overnight-slot Lean modules under morphoeval/lean/loops/ are template stubs, not mechanism proofs: their law1 is always `a * b`, whatever governing law the header names.
scan_definition: Scope: ALL files morphoeval/lean/loops/*.lean (repo-wide census, morphoeval/census_lean_stubs.py). Stub test: file contains the exact line `def law1_invariant (a b : Int) : Int := a * b`. NOTE: scout-058's draft scope excluded names starting Loop_0, which inadvertently excludes zero-padded overnight files (Loop_0101…); the registered scope is therefore the repo-wide census, and the threshold is applied to the repo-wide stub count. This correction is recorded here, before the resolution, not after it.
threshold: outcome_verdict = confirmed iff repo-wide stub count >= 2990 (scout-058's fixed threshold, applied to the corrected scope); otherwise refuted, with exact counts reported either way.
